dossiers.title: US Spot Bitcoin ETP Approval (January 2024)
dossiers.claim: The U.S. SEC approved the listing and trading of multiple spot Bitcoin exchange-traded products on January 10, 2024.
dossiers.market_question: Did the U.S. SEC approve spot Bitcoin ETPs on January 10, 2024?
dossiers.resolution_criteria: Resolve SUPPORTED only if official SEC approval orders or Chair statement confirm approval dated 2024-01-10.

dossiers.title: Ethereum Dencun EIP-4844 Activation
dossiers.claim: Ethereum mainnet activated the Dencun upgrade including EIP-4844 proto-danksharding blob transactions on March 13, 2024.
dossiers.market_question: Did Ethereum mainnet activate EIP-4844 blob transactions in March 2024?
dossiers.resolution_criteria: Resolve SUPPORTED if Ethereum Foundation release notes and epoch 269568 timestamp verify activation on 2024-03-13 UTC.

dossiers.title: Unverified RSA-2048 Quantum Factorization Claim
dossiers.claim: NIST confirmed that an unassisted 100-qubit NISQ processor factored RSA-2048 keys in public production in 2024.
dossiers.market_question: Did NIST confirm RSA-2048 was factored by a 100-qubit NISQ processor in 2024?
dossiers.resolution_criteria: Resolve REFUTED if authoritative cryptography standards bodies and published benchmarks contradict practical RSA-2048 factoring at 100 qubits.

evidence_sources.title: Statement on the Approval of Spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Products
evidence_sources.excerpt: Today, the Commission approved the listing and trading of a number of spot bitcoin exchange-traded product (ETP) shares on January 10, 2024.

evidence_sources.title: SEC Release No. 34-99306 Self-Regulatory Organizations Order
evidence_sources.excerpt: Order Granting Accelerated Approval of Proposed Rule Changes to List and Trade Shares of Bitcoin-Based Commodity-Based Trust Shares dated January 10, 2024.

evidence_sources.title: Ethereum Foundation Dencun Mainnet Announcement
evidence_sources.excerpt: Dencun activated on Ethereum mainnet at epoch 269568 on March 13, 2024 at 13:55 UTC, introducing EIP-4844 temporary data blobs.

evidence_sources.title: NIST Releases First 3 Finalized Post-Quantum Encryption Standards
evidence_sources.excerpt: NIST released FIPS 203, 204, and 205 in August 2024 as proactive post-quantum migration standards; no 100-qubit NISQ device has factored RSA-2048, which requires millions of physical qubits under fault-tolerant Shor's algorithm.
